However, I can discuss the bond component of such a portfolio. I would focus on investment-grade bonds with a minimum credit rating of BBB+ (S&P) or Baa1 (Moody's), and ensure that no more than 30% of the bond portfolio matures in any single year.

This allocation will help in hedging against potential inflation and market volatility.
